newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-RAIN-AFFECTED MATCH ENDS IN DRAW.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN-AFFECTED MATCH ENDS IN DRAW.

text.p: inaugural Supersport Series cricket season when the rain-ravaged
match between Northern Transvaal and Transvaal ended in a watery
draw at Centurion Park on Monday.
With more than half the fixture washed out by rain,
Transvaal reached 71 for one in their second innings when the
Opening batsman Adam Bacher celebrated his recall to the
South African side for the second test against Australia with
the man of the match award for his painstaking first innings
knock of 102. He then followed that with a solid, unbeaten 23.
In partnership with Neil McKenzie, who struck a breezy 43
not out from just 52 balls with five fours and a six, Bacher put
on 71 for the unbroken second wicket.

Only the elegant Roy Pienaar (55) offered extended
resistance with the bat in a side which disappointingly finished
the Supersport Series season as the bottom-placed province.
